description: <p>ISLAMABAD: Bushra Bibi, wife of former prime minister and PTI founder Imran Khan, has approached the Islamabad High Court (IHC), seeking an immediate medical examination by an ophthalmologist and permission to receive treatment from doctors of her choice at her own expense amid concerns over her deteriorating eyesight.</p> <p>Bushra Bibi is serving a seven-year sentence in the £190 million corruption case. headline: Pakistani astronaut to join Shenzhou-24 mission to China's space station
description: <p>A Pakistani astronaut will travel to China’s Tiangong space station aboard the Shenzhou-24 mission, becoming the first foreigner to visit the orbiting outpost, Beijing’s manned space agency said on Saturday.</p> <p>Pakistan and China are close diplomatic and strategic partners, and signed a deal in February 2025 setting up a Chinese government training programme for Pakistani astronauts.</p> <p>The statement by the China National Space Administration (CNSA) did not give a date of departure, but the mission is expected to take place by the end of the year.</p
